events.title: MTV Launched
events.blurb: Music Television (MTV) launched in the US on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' as its first broadcast video.

angles.name: The day the video star was born
angles.copy: On this day in 1981, MTV launched, kicking off with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star'. The irony, right? What was the first music video that truly blew your mind?

events.title: Oasis' Definitely Maybe Released
events.blurb: Oasis released their debut album 'Definitely Maybe' in 1994, becoming a landmark of Britpop.

angles.name: A Britpop masterpiece
angles.copy: 32 years ago today, Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe'. An album that defined a generation and launched them into superstardom. What's your favourite track from this absolute classic?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place over three days in August 1969, becoming a pivotal moment in music history.

angles.name: Peace, Love & Music
angles.copy: Remembering the iconic Woodstock Festival, which kicked off on this day in 1969. Three days that changed music and culture forever. If you could have been there, which artist would you have wanted to see most?

events.title: Elvis Presley Tribute
events.blurb: It's the anniversary of the death of the 'King of Rock and Roll', Elvis Presley, who passed away in 1977.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: On this day, we pay tribute to the one and only Elvis Presley. His music and charisma continue to captivate generations. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Tupac Shakur Tribute
events.blurb: It's the anniversary of the tragic shooting of influential rapper Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas in 1996, who later died from his injuries.

angles.name: Remembering a legend
angles.copy: On this day, we remember Tupac Shakur. A voice that defined a generation and whose impact on music and culture remains profound.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
events.blurb: It's the anniversary of the death of guitar legend Jimi Hendrix, who passed away in 1970.

angles.name: The Electric Church
angles.copy: Remembering Jimi Hendrix on the anniversary of his passing. His groundbreaking guitar work changed music forever. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' in 1969, featuring the famous zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: That iconic walk
angles.copy: On this day in 1969, The Beatles released 'Abbey Road'. More than just an album, it gave us one of the most famous album covers of all time! What's your favourite track from it?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday, Chrissie!
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and attitude have rocked stages for decades. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis and Beady Eye frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Always original, always rock 'n' roll. What's your favourite Liam moment or song?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' UK Single Release
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine all the people...
angles.copy: On this day in 1975, John Lennon's powerful single 'Imagine' was released in the UK. A song that still resonates globally. What does 'Imagine' mean to you?

events.title: First iPod Released
events.blurb: Apple released the first generation iPod in 2001, revolutionising portable music with '1,000 songs in your pocket'.

angles.name: The music revolution in your pocket
angles.copy: Remember this? On this day in 2001, Apple unveiled the very first iPod. It changed how we listened to music forever! Did you have one of the originals?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, not stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating over 60 years of 007. What's your all-time favourite Bond film or theme song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: It's the birthday of The Beatles co-founder John Lennon, who would have been 86 today.

angles.name: Remembering a legend
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the unparalleled genius of John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: And now for something completely different...
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is unmatched. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: The iconic White Album
angles.copy: On this day in 1968, The Beatles released their groundbreaking 'White Album'. A double album packed with diverse tracks. What's your hidden gem from this masterpiece?
